name: Umbral-Mausoleum

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by dead riverbeds and dry ocean basins and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Instruments disagree about the exotic matter deposit: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
